title: STAR's Item Backports
description: This is a resource pack for 1.12.2 that retextures certain features to the ones from the newer versions. This pack is experimental and may cause glitches.
body:
Hello! This is the first resource pack that I have made, and I decided to post this online.

So, as the title may have suggested, this pack backports newer textures to the old versions. But, this is not the same as other backport packs. What are the differences, you may ask? Well, this pack **do not** update textures, but _changing_ them to a similar block/item that wasn't available yet in the older versions.

CREDITS TO MOJANG FOR THE TEXTURES. I **_DO NOT_** OWN THESE TEXTURES.

So, why did I want to make this pack? The answer is simple--because I want to see if it's possible for the 'new' features to blend in with the old ones.

Scroll down for spoilers!

**NOTE: DUE TO UNKOWN REASONS SOME OF THE TEXTURES DIDN'T LOAD PROPERLY IN-GAME.**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
